_meta._note: Chapter 71, Final test (ch71-test, new). Sixteen multiple-choice questions at 80 % (12/16 fails, 13/16 passes): a single-word state and whose state it is (q01–02), a state clause and its contrast with a separate event (q03–04), a number and a measure (q05–06), a clarified statement and its contrast with a state (q07–08), a time word and an emphatic verbal noun (q09–10), a new sentence and a short text (q11–12) and one decision from each part of Al-Fajr plus a whole-surah decision (q13–16). Every item is a fresh sentence, not a verbatim repeat of a guided check. Correct options are placed 4 / 4 / 4 / 4. Added 2026-10-04 in the proposal harvest, batch 10 (Docs/proposals/proposal-harvest-tracker.md), from Docs/proposals/chapter-71-content-proposal.md and its review amendments.
